svdd.bandwidth: per-head sampled median positive squared distance

decision_rule: Proceed only to larger validation if SVDD is competitive with SnapKV and beats random/recency at tight budgets on full-cache-capable retrieval, adds value over KeyDiff/Knorm, and preprocessing cost is plausible. Pilot cannot establish publication significance.
limitations: one older open model, four-bit weights
SnapKV-style and sink/recency adaptations, not official CUDA implementations
shared full cache retained in paired harness; KV tensor byte savings do not imply peak process memory savings
